# FastSimulator equivalence check

Commit 6b314a646bd10fbb7ef3869e8e3a358301ad08a6. Label (none); episodes driven by R6 (greedy), each run on the Python simulator and on FastSimulator; every record compared with `==` (controller `decide_ms` aside), then the generator state, backlog and queue.

## Phase B degradation scenarios

- seeds 3100 to 3399 (300 episodes, 180000 windows)
- identical episodes: **300 / 300** (Python `Simulator` vs `FastSimulator`, class checked per episode)
- episode wall time (with R6): Python 33878 s, fast 1142 s (x29.7)

## Phase A scenarios

- seeds 1100 to 1199 (100 episodes, 12000 windows)
- identical episodes: **100 / 100** (Python `Simulator` vs `FastSimulator`, class checked per episode)
- episode wall time (with R6): Python 2169 s, fast 75 s (x29.1)
